doc.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: I want to – We’ll stop now. I can’t thank you enough. You’ve been extremely generous. I know it’s been very taxing for you to spend this many hours doing this, but it’s been very good for me personally.
I really enjoyed it. Thank you very much.
Thank you so much. If you need anything else added from time to time, just call me up and come on back and we’ll do some more.
Okay. [Transcribed by Barry Kernfeld from digital copies of the original tapes.]
